Fragrance guides, attar tips & stories from Perfume Paradise

Write for Perfume Paradise

Have a fragrance-related article you'd like to publish on our blog? We welcome guest contributions.

Guidelines

  • Original content only, focused on fragrance, attars, perfume care, or gifting.
  • 400–900 words, written in clear, simple English.
  • No direct promotion of competing perfume brands or stores.
  • We may lightly edit for clarity before publishing.
  • You'll be credited as the author on the published post.
Our story

Fragrance, made simple

Perfume Paradise started with a simple idea: everyone should be able to find a fragrance they love without paying luxury prices for it. We work directly with attar and perfume-oil suppliers to bring you long-lasting scents inspired by the world's most-loved perfumes.

Every bottle is filled fresh to order, and every fragrance is available in 3ml, 6ml, or 12ml, so you can try something new before committing to a full size — or stock up on your everyday favourite.

We're based in Gujranwala, Punjab, and deliver across Pakistan with a flat Rs. 300 delivery charge, cash on delivery included.
